description: This source file defines the PdfShading class used for representing and configuring shading patterns within a PDF document, including methods for setting up gradients with brush objects, and internal definitions of shading types and properties.

classes.name: PdfShading
classes.description: Represents a shading dictionary used for gradient fills in PDFs, allowing configuration of gradient parameters, color spaces, and functions.

classes.name: PdfShading.Keys
classes.description: Contains static string constants defining keys used in PDF shading dictionaries, including shading types, color space, coordinates, functions, and other properties.

methods.name: SetupFromBrush
methods.description: Configures the PdfShading object based on the provided XLinearGradientBrush, setting gradient coordinates, colors, and associated functions.
